title: Obtain Desired Standard Deviation
source_topic: CodeChef / ACM ICPC 2017, Online Preliminary Round
statement: Given two integers N and σ , find any array a with length N such that the standard deviation of the elements of the array is equal to σ . The standard deviation is given by the following formula: For each 1 ≤ i ≤ N , a i may be any real number with |a i | ≤ 10 8 .
